data.one_liner: Annotations for the auto_mappr code-generator to map between objects.
data.what_it_does: Provides the @AutoMappr annotation and configuration options like MapType to define mapping rules between different objects. It works alongside a code generator to generate the mapping implementation automatically.
use_when: You need to map data transfer objects (DTOs) to domain models and vice versa.
You want declarative object-to-object mapping generated at build time.
avoid_when: You prefer manual mapping or runtime reflection-based mapping.
You are not using the companion auto_mappr code generator.
strengths: Simplifies object mapping definition with annotations.
Supports custom constructors, type converters, and reverse mapping options.
weaknesses: Only provides annotations; requires the separate auto_mappr package for generation logic.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and setting up the companion auto_mappr code generator in your project.
